hooks.text: 穿行150余星球并从商店经营成长为贸易枢纽
hooks.excerpt: This is an AI-driven space trading & dynamic world RPG. You travel across 150+ planets in a dynamic universe with 600+ intelligent NPCs. Start as a novice trader, run your own shop, build a powerful trade guild, and become a major player connecting factions across the galaxy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: NPC立场、关系与选择实时改写供需和价格
hooks.excerpt: The economy and world are driven by AI. Supply, demand, and prices are not fixed but shaped by the stances, relationships, and choices of NPCs. Trading isn’t just about making profits; it’s about reshaping civilizations.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 借预言预判战争崩盘并反向改写NPC决定
hooks.excerpt: In the cycles of Neon River, prophecies reveal signs of wars, disasters, and market crashes. You can adjust your trade routes and alliances accordingly — or try to defy the prophecy by changing NPC decisions and Neon River’s future. Every glimpse into the future is an opportunity to rewrite destiny.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
